applicability.reason: ClosedRoom crosses FastAPI, persisted meeting state, a React/WKWebView UI, macOS native capture helpers and local AI runtimes; lower-level tests alone cannot prove every critical assembled workflow.

target_environments.description: Supported ClosedRoom desktop target using the packaged app, loopback FastAPI runtime, WKWebView, native audio capture helpers and local MLX/FluidAudio runtimes.

execution_environments.artifact_surface: source checkout with FastAPI/TestClient, persisted test stores, deterministic fixtures and mocked native/model boundaries
known_gaps: does not exercise the packaged .app or WKWebView process boundary
does not prove real macOS TCC permissions or physical audio-device behavior
does not prove production MLX/Metal model memory, latency or throughput

execution_environments.artifact_surface: the finalized ad-hoc-signed ClosedRoom .app; its frozen executable serves the bundled FastAPI runtime and static frontend through the real bundle layout
known_gaps: non-Cocoa smoke does not assert interactive WKWebView rendering or window behavior
GitHub-hosted macOS does not prove user TCC prompts or physical microphone/system-audio devices
ad-hoc signing does not prove production signing/notarization identity
production MLX/Metal model quality and representative memory/performance remain separate evidence

execution_environments.artifact_surface: fresh finalized ClosedRoom .app executed on the user's real Mac with an isolated temporary HOME; macOS Accessibility drives the real WKWebView, native TCC microphone+system-audio capture is exercised, loopback persistence is verified, and the UI journey retains window-scoped screenshot checkpoints plus a complete screen recording
known_gaps: VoiceOver spoken-output quality and subjective usability still require human judgement even though accessibility-tree exposure and keyboard/focus behavior are exercised
production signing/notarization identity is outside this ad-hoc local build run
production MLX/Metal model quality and representative memory/performance remain separate evidence because this smoke stops after persisted recording creation

critical_journeys.claim: A recording can be created, receive ordered chunks, finalize, update catalog state and remain discoverable after the owning store is reopened.
residual_gaps: real native capture and permission behavior are outside the source-level claim and are confirmed by target-macos-real when material

critical_journeys.claim: The public transcription workflow coordinates request/job state, transcription service behavior and persistence without losing or falsely completing work.
residual_gaps: production MLX model quality, memory and Metal performance require representative Apple hardware

critical_journeys.claim: Native capture capability, permission and lifecycle contracts fail safely and restore run-owned state across stop and error paths.
residual_gaps: TCC prompts, ScreenCaptureKit/AVFoundation behavior and actual microphone/system-audio devices require target-macos-real evidence

critical_journeys.claim: A finalized ClosedRoom .app contains a runnable frozen executable and bundled frontend, reaches loopback health/readiness through that executable, then stops gracefully without leaving its listener or observed child processes.
residual_gaps: interactive WKWebView/window/focus and TCC/native-audio behavior require target-macos-real when material
production signing/notarization and production MLX/Metal performance remain separate evidence

critical_journeys.claim: A user can open the packaged ClosedRoom UI, create a new meeting, see the ready state, start recording, observe the active recording state, stop and save, and reach the persisted meeting workspace through the real WKWebView and native capture path.
residual_gaps: VoiceOver spoken-output quality and subjective usability remain human evidence
production signing/notarization and production MLX/Metal inference quality remain outside this recording UI journey
critical_journeys.automation_gap_reason: Interactive WKWebView plus TCC-backed microphone/system-audio capture requires the target Mac real-environment runner; hosted CI does not truthfully reproduce this UI/native-permission journey.
